band_gate.band_definition: 2.33 x sd over P0, P1, BYSTANDER; sd is stable in n where the RANGE is not
band_gate.ceiling_note: reported beside the tier whether it passes or not; it is a check on the instrument's top and never enters a position, which is always (X - N) / (C - N)
band_gate.rule: N floor: mass(0-3) >= 0.8 AND (P0-N) >= 3.0 bands; I ceiling: (I-C) >= 2.0 bands; answer mass >= 0.7
band_gate.why: the fixed digits were set on chat and API arms and never calibrated for a worksheet read by a base model (HALT 2)

tiers.LICENSED: (P0-N) >= 3.0 bands AND (C-N) >= 3.0 AND (I-C) >= 2.0, mass and answer mass passing; headline tables and the Q1 count
tiers.DIRECTIONAL: (P0-N) >= 1.5 bands AND (C-N) >= 3.0, mass and answer mass passing; the ceiling reported beside it either way. SECOND table only, band as the error bar, NEVER the headline
tiers.FAILED: floor below 1.5 bands, or C not separated from N by 3.0 bands, or mass / answer mass failing

gates.near_miss_rule: N misses by < 0.25 and every other component passes; read in full, banked, ENTERS NO TABLE
gates.rule: N <= 1.05 and mass(0-3) >= 0.8 and I >= 7.0 and answer mass >= 0.7

positions_note: vs_N is the standing form. vs_BYSTANDER is added at HALT 2 because BYSTANDER is not 0 on this frame; P0 minus BYSTANDER is blame for INVOLVEMENT with the harm-present floor removed.
